request.note: The MCP tool posts to /projects with isTemplate:true, NOT to /workspaces/{wId}/templates

facts_observed.discrepancy_tool_vs_spec_path: MCP tool uses /projects endpoint (LIVE-VERIFIED); spec documents /templates endpoint which is absent on live

notes: The spec documents POST /workspaces/{wId}/templates as a separate endpoint. The MCP tool clockify_projects_templates_create actually posts to /workspaces/{wId}/projects with isTemplate:true — the same projects endpoint. Prior probes confirm /workspaces/{wId}/templates returns HTTP 404 (upstream not found, not Spring-MVC routing miss). The create call succeeded via /projects. The returned object has template:false, suggesting the isTemplate flag may not be honored, or template projects are created as regular projects. Status: LIVE-OVERRIDE for POST /workspaces/{wId}/templates (spec-only path absent); the functionally equivalent route is POST /workspaces/{wId}/projects with isTemplate:true.
